info.title: Matomo Reporting API for Tour plugin

get.description: Get all challenges that can be completed by a super user.

row.name: Embed a tracking code
row.description: Matomo offers you various ways to embed the tracking code for your website, mobile app, and even for any device or application.

row.name: Add a goal
row.description: Conversion tracking is a great way to identify whether you are meeting your current objectives, to identify new ones, view and analyse performance. You can also learn to increase your conversions, conversion rates, and revenue per visit.

row.name: Upload your logo
row.description: You can customize the Matomo logo which will be displayed in the user interface and email reports.

row.name: Invite a user
row.description: Users Management lets you add new users, edit existing users and give them access to view or administrate websites.

row.name: Add another website
row.description: Websites management lets you add a new website and edit existing websites.

row.name: Flatten a page report
row.description: Go to Behaviour \u2192 Pages and click the cog icon in the bottom of the report to flatten it. This changes the hierarchy from a grouped report to a list.

row.name: Change a visualisation
row.description: Browse a report and select the visualisation icon at the bottom of a report to change its visualisation.

row.name: Set up your dashboard
row.description: Add widgets to your dashboard to ensure it reports all your most important metrics.

formatRequired.name: format
formatRequired.description: Response format such as `xml` or `json`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

formatOptional.name: format
formatOptional.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

flatOptional.name: flat
flatOptional.description: Flatten subtables into the parent table.

filter_columnOptional.name: filter_column
filter_columnOptional.description: Column to apply the regex to (e.g., `label`).

filter_column_recursiveOptional.name: filter_column_recursive
filter_column_recursiveOptional.description: Column for the recursive regex filter.

filter_excludelowpopOptional.name: filter_excludelowpop
filter_excludelowpopOptional.description: Column to threshold and exclude low values.

filter_truncateOptional.name: filter_truncate
filter_truncateOptional.description: Row index after which rows are removed.

filter_limitOptional.name: filter_limit
filter_limitOptional.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

hideColumnsOptional.name: hideColumns
hideColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to hide.

showColumnsOptional.name: showColumns
showColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include.

labelOptional.name: label
labelOptional.description: Keep only rows with these label(s). Supports path via '>' and arrays.
